goal: Create real hot events and discover the public EventResult representation
command: from cubedynamics import data,pipe,verbs as v; import json; cube=data.temperature(source="prism",statistic="maximum",bbox=[-105.30,39.95,-105.20,40.05],start="2024-07-01",end="2024-07-31"); condition=pipe(cube)|v.quantile_state(quantile=0.8,direction="above",name="unusually_warm"); events=condition|v.detect_events(min_duration=1,max_gap=0); out=events.unwrap(); print("CONDITION_STATE",condition.semantic_state.as_dict()); print("TYPE",type(out).__name__); print("PUBLIC",[n for n in dir(out) if not n.startswith("_")]); print("REPR",out); print("PIPE_STATE",json.dumps(events.semantic_state.as_dict(),indent=2,default=str)); print("TRACE",json.dumps([s.as_dict() for s in events.semantic_trace],indent=2,default=str)); print("EXPLAIN",events.explain()); print("VALIDATE",events.validate()); print("CATALOG",out.catalog); print("CUBE",out.cube)
expected_behavior: A quantile condition over real PRISM temperature becomes local-cell events with an inspectable catalog and explicit scope
